name: Vercel
description: Vercel MCP is Vercel’s official MCP server, allowing you to search and navigate documentation, manage projects and deployments, and analyze deployment logs—all in one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vercel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vercel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vercel.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vercel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vercel provides these MCP tools: search_vercel_documentation, list_projects, get_project, list_deployments, get_deployment, get_deployment_events, and list_teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vercel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vercel in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Vercel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vercel is developed by Vercel. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
